idea: Picture 1 is Bix, a grumpy hairless cat. Picture 2 is Lilo, a purple fox. Picture 3 is Snow, a white tiger. Bix and Lilo sneak through the forest to steal the golden apple Snow is sleeping beside. Snow wakes up and chases them, they trip into a stream, and in the end the three of them share the apple on a log.

panels.prompt: Full-color cinematic film still, wide establishing shot, overcast forest at dawn — dense trees loom overhead, moss-covered roots twist into the foreground. Bix crouches low on frame-left, twitching ear forward as if sensing danger. Lilo glides silently behind him, paws barely touching ground, her purple fur blending with shadows. Snow sleeps peacefully beside a fallen tree trunk, curled up near a glowing golden apple that rests atop it. Bix is the grumpy hairless cat from the first image. Lilo is the purple fox from the second image. Snow is the white tiger from the third image.
panels.intent: The camera holds steady to establish tension between stealthy thieves and their target’s oblivious slumber.

panels.prompt: Medium shot, slightly lower angle, tracking leftward through underbrush — leaves rustle faintly as Bix and Lilo dart past ferns and thorny vines toward the sleeping tiger. Their bodies are tense but silent; Bix stares ahead with narrowed eyes while Lilo keeps one paw extended like she's guiding. Behind them, Snow stirs slightly — his head lifts just enough for an eye blink before he settles back down again. Bix is the grumpy hairless cat from the first image. Lilo is the purple fox from the second image. Snow is the white tiger from the third image.
panels.intent: Camera moves subtly along their path to emphasize how close they’ve gotten without being seen — the moment of impending discovery hangs heavy.

panels.prompt: Close-up, high-angle shot from above — snowflakes drift gently downward as Snow suddenly sits bolt upright, claws digging into earth, mouth open mid-growl. His body is rigid, muscles coiled tight against the cold air. In front of him, Bix freezes mid-step, ears flattened backward, tail flicked nervously. Lilo scrambles sideways, slipping slightly off balance as branches snap beneath her feet. Bix is the grumpy hairless cat from the first image. Lilo is the purple fox from the second image. Snow is the white tiger from the third image.
panels.intent: Focuses entirely on Snow’s sudden awakening — this panel captures the explosive shift from calm to chaos, freezing the instant before pursuit begins.

panels.prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Bix — water rushes violently upward as both cats tumble backwards into a shallow streambed. Water splashes wildly around them, sending ripples outward across rocks and submerged logs. Lilo flails desperately trying to keep dry, while Bix scrabbles frantically using only his paws. Snow watches from shore, half-hidden by reeds, snarling loudly despite having lost sight of them. Bix is the grumpy hairless cat from the first image. Lilo is the purple fox from the second image. Snow is the white tiger from the third image.
panels.intent: Emphasizes disorientation and slapstick comedy — the scene ends abruptly here so animation can focus on chaotic movement rather than resolution yet.

panels.prompt: Low-angle medium shot centered on a floating log drifting slowly downstream — three animals sit together awkwardly upon its surface: Snow lies sprawled out flat, legs dangling, looking utterly exhausted after chasing. Bix curls tightly next to him, chin resting on his paws, clearly annoyed. Lilo leans forward eagerly, licking her own muzzle while holding the golden apple aloft with her tiny forepaw. Light filters softly through canopy above, casting dappled patterns onto all three. Bix is the grumpy hairless cat from the first image. Lilo is the purple fox from the second image. Snow is the white tiger from the third image.
panels.intent: Momentary peace breaks free — now sharing what was stolen, each character has found something real beyond rivalry or hunger.

panels.prompt: Tight close-up, framed vertically — hands reach tentatively toward the apple as Snow opens his jaws wide to take bite number two, then pauses mid-chew. Bix looks away disgustedly, nose wrinkled, while Lilo beams proudly, tail wagging fast even though she doesn’t know why anyone would want to share food unless forced. Golden light gleams briefly off the fruit’s skin as steam rises faintly from where someone recently bit into it. Bix is the grumpy hairless cat from the first image. Lilo is the purple fox from the second image. Snow is the white tiger from the third image.
panels.intent: Final emotional payoff — not victory nor defeat, but acceptance of shared humanity (or felinehood) — ending quietly hopeful amid natural beauty.
